items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno, una de las principales plataformas de música con inteligencia artificial y objeto de demandas por derechos de autor en varios frentes, ha lanzado su suite de modelos v6, la primera que la compañía desarrolla con socios de la industria: Warner Music Group, BMG y Believe. Con este estreno, la firma retira simultáne…

items.title: UMG firma un acuerdo global de IA con ElevenLabs
items.summary: Universal Music Group (UMG) ha firmado un acuerdo de licencia plurianual con ElevenLabs, la compañía de inteligencia artificial de audio valorada en 11.000 millones de dólares. Es el primer pacto de ElevenLabs con una gran discográfica y contempla el lanzamiento de una nueva plataforma de música con IA para fans, ademá…

items.title: Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
5 things You Need to Know About ElevenLabs, the UMG AI partner with an $11B valuation – and big ambitions in music.
items.summary: UMG and ElevenLabs announced a licensing agreement, which will see the latter build a fan platform for remixes, mashups, and "new track interpretations." Source

items.title: ElevenLabs unveils ‘Music v2.5’ – but UMG wasn’t involved
items.summary: Fresh from announcing a licensing deal with Universal Music Group, ElevenLabs has unveiled the latest version of its ElevenMusic AI-music service… while stressing that UMG is not involved in the latter. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Will You Please Stop Suing Us Now? Suno Turns a Legit Leaf With ‘v6’ as Warner Music’s Kyncl Leads the Licensed AI Pep Rally
items.summary: Moments after announcing a Believe partnership deal, Suno is now rolling out its Warner Music- and BMG-backed v6 models – with an eye on expanding into “opt-in experiences built around individual artists.” The sudden shift marks a big departure from earlier, non-licensed content grabs, but is it too late for Suno to sh…

items.title: EU Kids Act set to restrict social media, video, games and AI
items.summary: There have been rumours recently of imminent legislation introducing a social-media ban for children in the European Union. It seems the bill will now debut on Thursday (17 September). The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Canciones creadas con IA abren un nuevo debate sobre derechos de autor
ElevenLabs launched Music v2.5 – shortly after announcing its UMG licensing deal.
items.summary: The model went live on September 11 and is now the default “for prompted and reference generation” in ElevenMusic, the company said. Source

items.title: Universal Music and ElevenLabs Ink Multi-Year Partnership Deal, Say They’re Already Developing ‘A New AI-Powered Music Creation Platform’
items.summary: Another day, another high-profile AI licensing deal: Universal Music Group (UMG) and ElevenLabs are now collaborating to develop a “platform built on licensed music and artist participation.” The major label and the well-funded AI developer, which has been aggressively expanding into music since August 2025, formally d…

items.title: ElevenLabs Launches Its ‘Best Music Model Yet’ in v2.5 — While Emphasizing That Universal Music’s Walled Garden ‘Deal Is Separate’
items.summary: ElevenLabs has officially launched ElevenMusic v2.5 – but not with its newest partner, Universal Music Group (UMG), which is collaborating on the development of a different product. ElevenLabs rolled out v2.5 on Friday, emphasizing in the corresponding announcement that the model “is now the default for prompted and re…

items.title: Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.summary: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, which has been developed with its industry partners like Warner Music, BMG and Believe. However, even as it starts to work with some labels and publishers on new AI products, it continues to fight other music companies in the courts

tip.title: Voz clonada: el derecho en juego suele no ser el copyright
tip.body: Imitar la voz de un artista con IA rara vez es infracción de copyright de la canción; el reclamo típico va por derechos de imagen, voz y publicidad, que varían mucho entre jurisdicciones.

tip.title: Cloned vocals: copyright is usually not the issue
tip.body: Mimicking an artist's voice with AI is rarely a copyright infringement of the song itself; claims typically run through name, image, voice and publicity rights, which vary widely by jurisdiction.
